name: @workbench/cli
description: Shared agentic software-development context, records, and change gates

scripts.format:check: node node_modules/prettier/bin/prettier.cjs --check src "tests/**/*.mts" tests/tsconfig.json "scripts/**/*.mts" scripts/*-assets.json scripts/bootstrap-tools.json scripts/package-manager/*.json scripts/container-tools/*.json "examples/**/managed-release-check.json" "examples/**/release-musl.json" ".devcontainer/**/*.json" "examples/**/scripts/*.mts" bin/*.mjs bin/*.cts package.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.mts vitest.config.mts .prettierrc.json .pnpmfile.cjs
scripts.format: node node_modules/prettier/bin/prettier.cjs --write src "tests/**/*.mts" tests/tsconfig.json "scripts/**/*.mts" scripts/*-assets.json scripts/bootstrap-tools.json scripts/package-manager/*.json scripts/container-tools/*.json "examples/**/managed-release-check.json" "examples/**/release-musl.json" ".devcontainer/**/*.json" "examples/**/scripts/*.mts" bin/*.mjs bin/*.cts package.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.mts vitest.config.mts .prettierrc.json .pnpmfile.cjs
scripts.lint: node node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js --config eslint.config.mjs src tests scripts bin "examples/**/scripts/*.{mjs,mts}" --max-warnings 0 .pnpmfile.cjs eslint.config.mjs vitest.config.mjs eslint.config.mts vitest.config.mts
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run bundle:check && pnpm run test
scripts.bundle:build: pnpm run tooling:build && pnpm run typecheck && node scripts/build-bundle.mjs
